§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Umbral Mire can be collected in Prosperity's Fumarole Swamp. Air homogenization and dissolution split vegetal-mineral, organic, and fiber routes that recover fertilizer, raw bio fiber, plant balls, and minerals. Check one named raw-fluid cell filled with §11000§r mB of Umbral Mire. §2The cell is not consumed§r; building the industrial line is not required.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Keep an unprocessed full cell for the check rather than confusing the raw mire with homogenized or dissolved intermediates. Its plant, organic, and fiber branches serve different needs and can be selected accordingly. This quest requires no fertilizer or fiber production. Later, inspect each recipe stage and provide outlets for the different item and fluid products.
